scientific_integrity: Exact fixed-positive-rate star limit established by generator convergence and unique stationary PDMP density; finite-n variance established by closed stationary spin moments. Numerical checks corroborate, not prove, the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Not a claim about general graph families, rate limits depending on graph size, stationary mixing times, or convergence rates. Possible unindexed historical equivalent star stationary law remains a priority risk.
title: An affine beta law for noisy-voter polarization on growing star networks
